title: actinostachys pennula
intro: Actinostachys pennula, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Osmundaceae. It is traditionally used in Maori medicine for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. Bioactive constituents of Actinostachys pennula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential applications in modern medicine.
